name: newcodexJS/20-marketplace-platform
top_fix: Rewrite 05-PRACTICE.md and 02-CONCEPTS.md for the marketplace domain: they are a 1-line noun swap of 19-realtime-chat-platform's course (1 of 47 lines differ).
summary: Strong, real change: additive status_before_archive migration, lifecycleUpdate with SELECT FOR UPDATE, idempotent archive/restore, bulk status that dedupes IDs, locks all targets in ID order, rejects the batch on a missing ID and writes true before/after audit rows. 4 tests assert stored rows, not status codes; checks.json + 71-tests.log + 22 real browser API requests back every claim. Course text is the weak half: 05-PRACTICE is near-identical to its sibling clones, 07-TRACE-LAB repeats one paragraph 6x, and client runBulkStatus (App.tsx:124) has no try/catch so the new bulk 404 surfaces no UI error.

name: recipeview
top_fix: Document the undocumented error-handling change: fail() now returns the opaque string "Request failed" for every non-InputError 500, while 04-TESTING tells the learner to debug by reading the response.
summary: Good small-stack lesson: one request boundary in the existing h() wrapper now canonicalises :id params and runs validatePayload over every POST/PATCH body before any row is touched, isDate rejects impossible calendar dates, and the app exports app so it can be imported without binding a port. The 3 tests are real HTTP integration tests against a temp SQLite dir and deepEqual the whole recipe after five rejected PATCHes. Deductions: the 500-message masking is never mentioned in the course, 04-TESTING has a duplicated stray code fence at lines 23-26 and a paragraph about three unrelated projects, and VERIFICATION cites PostgreSQL in a SQLite-only app.

name: calendar+jobtrack
top_fix: Fix the test count in VERIFICATION.md: it claims 92 automated test cases, but 90 are the app's pre-existing suite and Astra's delta is 2 it() blocks in src/lib/backup.test.ts.
summary: A thorough, domain-aware runtime validator (src/lib/backupValidation.ts, 137 lines) now runs inside parseBackup before any of four localStorage stores is replaced: real calendar dates, local datetimes without UTC conversion, end>start, recurrence bounds, per-collection ID uniqueness, dayEnd>dayStart, salary ordering. The course is honest that validating first still does not make the multi-store write atomic, and that unknown categoryIds are still accepted. Deductions: the 92-test claim counts the inherited suite; the touched files were reformatted to double-quote/semicolon style that no other file in src/ uses; and the version check silently narrowed from > to !== (old backups now rejected) without being taught as a compatibility trade-off.

name: devdeck
top_fix: Rewrite 07-TRACE-LAB boundaries to follow the real path (Settings.tsx:131 -> store.ts:295 -> validateImport -> the rw transaction in db.ts); all six boundaries currently repeat one sentence pointing at src/db.ts/importData, so the UI and store layers are never traced.
summary: validateImport (an 'asserts payload is ExportData' validator) now runs as the first statement of importData, before the Dexie rw transaction, so a malformed backup cannot half-replace progress. The 2 new tests exercise real Dexie via fake-indexeddb and, after each of four corruptions, re-export and compare states/settings/meta with the original -- a rollback test, not a throw test. Deductions: VERIFICATION reports the whole pre-existing 62-case suite as the deliverable; the trace lab's six boundaries all point at the same file; the code-quality.ts edit stripped braces from a nested if/else purely to satisfy a 12-line content rule inside a code-quality deck; and the project has no server, SQL or authz, so CRUD transfer is limited.

name: _Organized Desktop/08 App And Product Projects/job track
top_fix: Pin Node 22.16.x and give the npm rebuild better-sqlite3 fallback in README/VERIFICATION -- the native module is the likeliest fresh-machine failure and the course warns about it without naming a version.
summary: Best change in the batch and squarely on-stack. Optional fields now transform blank to null instead of undefined, so the PUT handler can distinguish omitted (keep) from blank (clear) from present (set); blank salaries stay null instead of coercing to 0; dates are refined to real calendar dates; list ordering gains an id tie-breaker; :id params must be canonical positive integers; a repeated status transition returns the existing row untouched before consulting ALLOWED_TRANSITIONS; and three Zustand object-selectors were split into scalar selectors, fixing a genuine v5 render loop. The 3 tests drive the real API over HTTP against a mkdtemp database and include a cross-user ownership check (second user gets 404 on PUT). Only the prose drags: 6 repeated trace-lab boundary paragraphs and 4 repeated review paragraphs.
